name: Bacteria Monster
Description: A dangerous creature associated with damp and humid environments. It is best avoided and should be approached with extreme caution.

name: Mimic
Description: A hostile entity capable of disguising itself as part of its surroundings and using deception to lure wanderers into danger.
Weaknesses: Recognition and maintaining a safe distance

name: Partygoer
Description: A hostile party-themed entity that uses a cheerful appearance and environment to disguise the danger surrounding it.

name: Party Pooper
Description: An entity associated with the party-themed environment that is generally considered non-hostile and can oppose Partygoers.

name: Smiler
Description: A dangerous entity commonly associated with darkness. Its distinctive appearance makes it particularly recognizable in poorly lit environments.

name: Hounds
Description: Fast and hostile creatures that can be encountered in dangerous areas. They are especially threatening when encountered unexpectedly.

name: Clump
Description: A hostile entity made up of multiple limbs that can be difficult to predict and dangerous at close range.
Weaknesses: Distance and exploiting its lack of coordination

name: Mr Kitty
Description: A dangerous entity with a distinctive feline appearance. Encounters should be treated cautiously because its behavior can be unpredictable.

name: The Animated King
Description: A powerful and intelligent entity associated with a strange animated and fantastical environment. It is considered extremely dangerous to confront directly.

name: Aranea Membri
Description: A dangerous spider-like entity associated with hotel environments. Wanderers should avoid close encounters.
